people.method: Reconciled every under-five profile with completed cached national exact-title discovery and country/prominence outcomes from rounds 117–126. New accepted pages were fetched with the official source-cache tool and their exact names, roles and country associations inspected. Sources stay in working files and provenance, never as widget citations.
